description: This PHP source file defines the class 'CaseEventsHook', which is responsible for tracking and recording changes to case records within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods to compare old and new versions of case beans to identify specific field changes and to trigger event creation accordingly.

classes.name: CaseEventsHook
classes.description: A hook class that detects changes in case records and records events when specified fields are modified.

methods.name: compareBeans
methods.description: Compares two bean objects representing old and new case data, detecting changes in specific fields and creating event beans accordingly.

methods.name: saveUpdate
methods.description: Handles the updating process for a case bean, retrieving the previous state and generating change events if necessary.
